argument: Both list-rendering regressions are real in the built PDF, and the scope ruling is book-wide, not a ch06-local micro-PR. The enum at ch06:91 puts three hard-wrapped formula lines in one bracket body with no per-line '+' item markers, so the renderer merges them into a single numbered paragraph (p123). The bare-line enum at 22-reference-sheets:239 fails identically (p361), while the four enums that do carry '+' markers (01-introduction:108 p23, 02-character-creation:26 p36, 19-gm-guidance:339 p307, 20-bestiary:667 p338) dodge the collapse but still mis-number as one outer entry containing lettered a/b/c sub-items. Those are two failure modes of one rule, so recommend one book-wide sweep PR that gives every '#enum(numbering: "1.")[' body per-line '+' prefixes and removes hard-wrapped lines. The former hyphen bullets at ch06:97-101 now print 1-5 (p123-124), and the same '+'-for-hyphen substitution runs through the book: 197 top-level '+' lines in 11 chapter files, with pre-migration ch13 and ch15 using hyphens and the PDF printing numbers at p203 and p234. Recommend a second book-wide sweep PR (a ch06-only edit would leave ten files with the same defect). Two narrower items: the doubled period is book-wide (20 instances, ch06's is 'Chapter 17..' on p124) and comes from chapter cross-references carrying their own trailing period, so fix the reference format or all 20 sites, not just this chapter; the minus-sign loss is genuinely ch06-only (pre-migration file had 7 U+2212, current file has none, while 08-disciplines, 13-combat and 21-glossary still carry U+2212), so restore those in the ch06 pass. Table captions are a pending book-wide convention decision (only 9 of 138 tables carry a numbered caption prefix), so do not edit ch06's captions in isolation. MIGRATION-SPEC structural traps are clean here: a single raw Typst fence with the H1 above it, all five tables carrying outlined:false, labels on the line after their headings, and all three callout bodies in the named form do render. Page flow is otherwise sound: no split tables, no orphaned headings, one near-empty page (p120), and the zero-em-dash law holds.
